facts.claim: MSC Seascape (MSC Cruises): Entered service 2022; 170,412 GT; 4540 guests (lower berth / double occupancy); 339 m length; Seaside EVO class.
MSC Seascape is a Seaside EVO-class cruise ship built for MSC Cruises at the Fincantieri shipyard in Monfalcone, Italy.

catalogSpecs.description: Seaside EVO-class; cruise ship operated by its listed cruise line; entered service 2022; 170,412 GT; approx. 4,540 guests at double occupancy.
